title: Wrong crate in a module
fix: Modules depend on `spacetimedb`; clients on `spacetimedb-sdk`. Never mix them.
symptom: compile errors about missing macros / ReducerContext

title: Table macro syntax
fix: Use `#[spacetimedb::table(accessor = player, public)]` on a struct (2.x); do NOT add #[derive(SpacetimeType)] to table structs.

title: Table access is a method
fix: Access tables as `ctx.db.player()` (method call) and use the generated index handles: `ctx.db.player().id().find(id)`.

title: Updating a row
fix: Fetch, mutate a copy, then `ctx.db.player().id().update(Player { hp: 10, ..p })`; updates go through a unique/primary index.

title: Reducer signature
fix: Reducers take `ctx: &ReducerContext` first and return () or Result<(), String>; return Err to roll back with a message.

title: Missing Table trait import
fix: `use spacetimedb::Table;` (and index traits) is required for insert/iter/count on table handles.

title: Scheduling API
fix: Use `#[table(accessor = tick_schedule, scheduled(game_tick))]` with `scheduled_at: ScheduleAt`; use ScheduleAt::Interval for repeating ticks, ScheduleAt::Time for one-shots. The keyword is `scheduled`, not `schedule`.

title: Scheduled reducers callable by clients
fix: Guard scheduled reducers: reject when ctx.sender() is not the module's own identity (ctx.database_identity() in 2.14), otherwise clients can trigger ticks.
symptom: players can speed up time/spawn loot

title: Nondeterminism in reducers
fix: Use ctx.rng() and ctx.timestamp; never std::time, thread_rng or HashMap iteration order for gameplay outcomes. For reproducible procgen use a seeded hash (e.g. FNV-1a -> splitmix64).

title: Identity to string
fix: Use `identity.to_hex().to_string()` (or store Identity directly); don't format with Debug.

title: init does not rerun
fix: init runs only on first publish (or --delete-data). Seed new tables in an idempotent ensure_* reducer or a schema-version table.

title: Destructive schema change
fix: Removing/reordering columns or changing types needs a wipe or a dual-table migration (new table + backfill reducer + switch). Plan schemas additively.
cause: automatic migration only handles additive changes

title: Subscribe after connect
fix: Register subscriptions in on_connect (or on the connected signal) and read the cache only after on_applied fires.

title: Client never pumps messages
fix: Call frame_tick()/run_threaded() (Rust), FrameTick() (C#/Unity Update), or keep the Godot node processing.

title: Godot tables need a primary key
fix: Give every client-visible table a #[primary_key]; the GDScript SDK cannot cache keyless rows.
symptom: rows arrive in callbacks but iter() is empty

title: Overlapping subscriptions in Godot
fix: Subscribe per AOI cell and unsubscribe cells you leave; don't rely on ref-counting of overlapping queries.
symptom: rows vanish when one of two overlapping subs is dropped

title: Unbounded subscriptions
fix: Never `SELECT * FROM entity` for world tables; filter by chunk/cell or region, and keep high-frequency position data in a narrow table separate from wide entity rows.
symptom: bandwidth and server CPU spike with player count
cause: fan-out = rows x subscribers x rate

title: Revoked player still connected
fix: Re-check admission in every reducer and in client_connected; kick by closing the connection or restart, since revoke rows don't drop sockets.

title: HTTP 504 after 2.13
fix: Treat 504 as unknown outcome; make HTTP-invoked reducers idempotent with a request-id dedup table.

title: Upgrade order for 2.14
fix: Upgrade the server/standalone first, then republish modules; is_internal() semantics changed.

title: HS256 tokens rejected
fix: Use an OIDC provider issuing RS256/ES256 tokens (SpacetimeAuth, Firebase via broker, Auth0...).

title: Opening data with a newer binary
fix: Copy the data dir and run the new server side-by-side on another port; never point a newer binary at the only copy.

title: Floating 'latest' CLI
fix: Pin the CLI/server with `spacetime version install X` / use X per project; record versions in a manifest.

title: Bindings drift
fix: Regenerate client bindings after every module publish (script it) and fail CI when generated files differ.
symptom: deserialization errors / missing reducers on client

title: Long reducers stall the world
fix: Every reducer blocks the database actor; keep tick reducers under a budget (e.g. <5 ms p95), batch work across ticks, move heavy compute to a sidecar.

title: Logging while hot
fix: Avoid verbose log::info in per-tick or per-entity paths; BitCraft's launch had a cascading failure tied to logging under load.
evidence: Developer Voices interview with Tyler Cloutier (2026)

title: Cross-database atomicity
fix: Async IDC is at-least-once with callbacks; design handoffs as idempotent state machines with explicit lock/offer/accept states and timeouts.
symptom: duplicated or lost players during region transfer

title: IDC is same-host only (2.14.0)
fix: Co-locate dependent databases on one host for now, or use a sidecar/HTTP bridge for cross-host.

title: Trusting client positions
fix: Validate movement server-side (max speed x dt, collision, cooldowns) in the reducer; clients send intents, not authoritative state.

title: Large static data in hot tables
fix: Keep immutable defs (items, terrain) in compact descriptor tables, load once, version with a generation stamp; avoid re-subscribing clients to them each session if they ship with the client.

title: Procedures are not reducers
fix: HTTP only from procedures; wrap writes in ctx.with_tx/try_with_tx; never block a reducer on network.

title: Licensed game data in repos
fix: Keep original commercial game assets outside the repo; reference an install path; never ship them in a kit.

title: New column refused on 2.13 even with a default
fix: On a live world put new fields in a side table keyed by the same id (player_ext). New tables publish fine.
symptom: publish refused when appending a column to an existing table, with or without a default
cause: 2.13 automatic migration did not add columns to existing tables

title: Defaulted new column disconnects every client (2.14.0)
fix: Appending a field with #[default(v)] is accepted and existing rows get the default, but the publish plan warns 'All clients will be disconnected due to breaking schema changes'. Prefer a side table on a live world; never put #[default] on pk/unique/auto_inc.
symptom: all clients drop after publish; or publish refused with 'Adding a column ... requires a default value annotation'
cause: an appended column is a breaking schema change for connected clients; without #[default] there is no value for existing rows
evidence: verified locally on 2.14.0 standalone (in-memory), 2026-11-01; scratch module, not in repo

title: RLS refuses nested IN subqueries
fix: Write client_visibility_filter SQL as a single-table WHERE or a JOIN, or better use a private table plus a #[view].
symptom: publish fails: 'failed to create row-level security ... Unsupported expression: id IN (SELECT ...)'
cause: RLS filter SQL does not support subqueries
evidence: verified locally on 2.14.0 standalone (in-memory), 2026-11-01; scratch module, not in repo; 2.10.1 from a field report

title: JOIN-based RLS breaks client JOIN subscriptions
fix: Do not combine a JOIN-based client_visibility_filter with client JOIN subscriptions on the same table. Expose per-player rows through a #[view] (ctx.sender()) instead.
symptom: subscribe fails: 'Invalid number of tables in subscription: 3' (2.14.0); live JOIN subscriptions stopped working (2.10.1)
cause: the RLS rewrite adds the filter's JOIN to the client's JOIN
evidence: verified locally on 2.14.0 standalone (in-memory), 2026-11-01; scratch module, not in repo; 2.10.1 from a field report

title: RLS is unstable in 2.14
fix: client_visibility_filter and Filter only exist with the spacetimedb crate feature 'unstable' and are doc-hidden. Treat RLS as unstable; prefer private tables plus views. In a local test the filter was enforced for other identities, while the publishing identity still saw all rows, so test RLS with a second, non-owner identity.
symptom: compile error: client_visibility_filter / Filter not found
evidence: spacetimedb 2.14.0 crate source (cfg(feature = "unstable")); verified locally on 2.14.0 standalone (in-memory), 2026-11-01; scratch module, not in repo

title: JOIN subscriptions need indexed join columns
fix: Add #[index(btree)] (or unique/primary key) on both join columns before subscribing with a JOIN.
symptom: subscribe fails: 'Subscriptions require indexes on join columns'
evidence: verified locally on 2.14.0 standalone (in-memory), 2026-11-01; scratch module, not in repo

title: Public reducer that can end every session
fix: Never expose module_update / kick_all / reset_world style reducers to every client. Gate with require_admin(ctx)? or an operator role (recipes/operator-role.md); keep destructive actions admin-only and log the caller.
symptom: any player can disconnect or reset the whole world
cause: an ops convenience reducer shipped without an authority check

title: UTF-8 BOM breaks JSON receipts
fix: Read JSON with encoding='utf-8-sig' (or strip a leading \ufeff); write JSON without a BOM. Windows PowerShell 5.1 'Set-Content -Encoding utf8' adds one; use [IO.File]::WriteAllText or PowerShell 7 utf8NoBOM.
cause: a receipt written by another tool started with EF BB BF
